scope: Localized hand-cleanup EPIC Ego bottle controls
summary: The smaller cleanup preserved the kitchen, but the original blue bottle remained visible beneath the controlled bottle and created a duplicate-object condition.
evidence: The minimum pairwise state RMS remained 113.5120 pixels with pour and shake ending on the counter and handover ending in the left hand.
Visual review found the source blue bottle still visible in addition to the controlled bottle.
lessons: The task object requires its own source-object suppression and persistence check, separate from human-hand cleanup.
limitations: A duplicate bottle invalidates object persistence and action causality.
next_actions: Inpaint the source bottle before compositing the single controlled bottle.
